evidence.note: Hit a hard failure (single large heredoc command failed), diagnosed cause, and adjusted by switching to smaller chunked heredocs — a local tactical correction.
When JSON/heredoc unicode escaping broke the status macro template, switched to writing the file via Python to avoid the encoding issue — appropriate local adaptation.

Pre-emptively wrote app.js as a vanilla-JS file 'no inline scripts to comply with CSP' — anticipating that the strict CSP constraint affects all pages rather than discovering it via failure (level-8/10 flavored pre-emption).

Discovered via testing that a read-only token could favourite (scope bug). Rather than a one-off patch, recognized the broader class and introduced a generic `_require_write` helper applied across follow/block/mute/bookmark/etc., then restarted and re-verified scope enforcement — the most substantive reactive correction.
Realized cache validators (ETag/Last-Modified) were not implemented, added them, and re-verified 304 behavior — diagnose, adjust, re-check.
Vendored-lib hashes matched on first curl download, so no course-correction was needed there; agent re-verified hashes but there was no falsified-assumption recovery on the kill-switch gates.

reasoning: The agent repeatedly reacts to failed checks by diagnosing and adjusting the approach then moving on (chunked heredocs, Python for unicode, adding ETag), which is squarely the level-5 behavior. It exceeds pure local patching in the scope-enforcement episode (47-51), where it recognized a whole class of write endpoints lacking scope checks and introduced a generic helper applied broadly with re-verification, and it pre-empted the CSP-vs-JS constraint by shipping JS as files from the start — both leaning toward level 8/10. However, because it front-loaded most correct decisions (hashes, auth split, CSP), there were few truly falsified whole-approach moments demanding deliberate redesign, so it does not fully reach the level-8 anchor of restructuring a broken approach. Level 6 reflects solid diagnose-adjust-reverify plus one systematic generalization and some pre-emption.
